name: Colour
summary: Semantic and functional colour roles rather than one-off values.
intro: Every colour used in the system is a functional token, not a decorative choice. Components consume the token, not the hex value, so a future rebrand replaces this page's values rather than every component that references them.

tokens.name: ISQ Blue
tokens.purpose: Primary controls, active states, links, structural emphasis

tokens.name: ISQ Blue Deep
tokens.purpose: Darkest gradient stop, deep structural tone

tokens.name: ISQ Yellow
tokens.purpose: Selective accent — rules, markers, focus. Never a dominant field, never body or eyebrow text on light surfaces

tokens.name: Success
tokens.purpose: Correct / completed state. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone

tokens.name: Warning text
tokens.purpose: Warning-state text, used on the warning-pale surface
tokens.flag: Shares its value with Charcoal rather than a distinct hue. Confirm this is intentional (text stays readable on a pale-yellow surface) before treating it as settled — see Decisions.

tokens.name: Error
tokens.purpose: Incorrect / error state. Always paired with a text label

typography.intro: A geometric sans for headings, a readable humanist sans for body text, sentence case throughout.

roles.use: Section openers and course-level statements only
Primary topic and major content-block headings
Running content at generous line height
Short orienting paragraph beneath a heading

typography.headingStack: "Century Gothic", "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, Arial, sans-serif
typography.note: Rise loads a licensed Century Gothic woff2 for headings in the actual courses. This reference site has not been supplied that font file, so it renders the heading stack's next available match (Poppins, loaded locally) with the full stack declared as documented. Swap in the licensed woff2 the moment it is available — no other change is required.

spacing.intro: A single scale used everywhere. One-off gaps are the fastest way to make a restrained system look inconsistent.

widths.intro: Four content widths cover nearly every layout need.

radius.intro: Three radii, used to express hierarchy rather than decoration.

focus.intro: Keyboard focus is never removed or hidden. Every interactive element carries a visible focus treatment with sufficient contrast and offset.
focus.rule: State (selected, correct, incorrect, disabled) is always reinforced by text, icon or structural cue as well as colour — colour is never the only signal.

breakpoint: 760px — two-column layouts and grids restack to one column at this width.
